input: How much does the Pro plan cost?
expected_output: The Pro plan costs $9 per user per month and includes 1 TB of storage per user and email support within 24 hours.

input: Can I get a refund if I cancel after two months?
expected_output: Refunds are only available within 14 days of the first payment, so a refund after two months is not possible. You can still cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the paid period.

input: I accidentally deleted a file last week. Is it gone forever?
expected_output: No. Deleted files stay in the Trash for 30 days, so a file deleted last week can still be restored from the Trash.

input: What's the biggest file I can upload on the free plan?
expected_output: On the Free plan the maximum single file size is 2 GB.

input: Do you offer an on-premise version I can host myself?
expected_output: The knowledge base doesn't cover an on-premise version, so the assistant should say it doesn't know and suggest contacting support@acme.example.
